agency.name: Division of Behavioral Health and Recovery (DBHR), Illinois Department of Human Services

narrNote: IAEC is listed as Illinois' affiliate on NARR's official affiliates page (narronline.org/affiliates) and states on its own site that it is the Illinois State Affiliate of NARR. Verified in-run 2026-10-22.
notes: Effective 2025, the former Division of Substance Use Prevention and Recovery (SUPR) and Division of Mental Health merged into the Division of Behavioral Health and Recovery (DBHR) under a February 2025 executive order; current IDHS pages confirm DBHR holds the substance use portfolio. Agency phone is the IDHS Help Line published on IDHS/HFS materials. The Illinois Helpline (1-833-2FINDHELP; text HELP to 833234) is the state's 24/7 substance-use line and runs MAR NOW for immediate medication access. Illinois has no county behavioral-health board system — services are delivered by DBHR-licensed community providers — so countyDirectory is null; the local peer layer is the ROSC council network, findable by county through the Governors State University hub. Medicaid SUD coverage is documented on the HFS (Illinois Medicaid agency) page linked.
